basics.name: Yiyang (Roy) Huang
basics.label: Applied AI Engineer
basics.summary: Software Design Sr. Engineer at Delta Electronics, focusing on Applied AI. My work and interests include LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, retrieval systems, and AI-powered software.

work.name: Delta Electronics
work.summary: Focused on Applied AI and the development of practical AI-powered software systems.
highlights: Develop and integrate LLM-based applications for practical software workflows
Work with RAG, retrieval systems, and AI agent architectures
Design backend components and data pipelines for AI applications
Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM and open-source AI technologies

work.name: MJ Health Research Foundation & National Taiwan University MIRLab
work.summary: Prediction of Biological Age Using Machine Learning.
highlights: Led machine learning model development for biological age prediction using large-scale health screening data
Applied MICE to handle missing values in large datasets
Built predictive models including LightGBM for lifespan and biological age estimation
Used SHAP to interpret model predictions and analyze feature importance

work.name: National Taiwan University Hospital & National Taiwan University MIRLab
work.summary: Detecting Intradialytic Hypotension Using Machine Learning.
highlights: Worked with large-scale hemodialysis clinical data
Participated in data preprocessing and missing-value imputation using MICE
Contributed to anomaly detection and predictive modeling
Participated in technical discussions with clinicians and prepared research reports

awards.title: Certificate of Academic Honors
awards.summary: Awarded for three years; ranked first.
